description: Search the NLCS 5.0.2 infrastructure library; returns parameters, connectors, material variants and source conflicts.
name: infra_catalog

description: Place a parametric infrastructure object or attach it to an existing instance. Coordinates in project metres; rotation in degrees. Conflict items require confirm=true and explicit design parameters. Returns instance, handles, ports and warnings.

at.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

items.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_place

description: Read saved infrastructure instances, parameters, connector positions and warnings from the active drawing.
name: infra_inspect

description: Regenerate a saved infrastructure instance and its connections atomically. Invalid or incompatible edits leave the drawing unchanged.

items.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_update

description: List the running Open CAD Studio windows; `select` picks one by session id, pid or drawing name.
name: infra_oi_sessions

description: The model: project location, axes (handles), length and design profiles, corridors, existing (B) and design (N) terrain, survey points.
name: infra_oi_status

description: Run one command line: Open Infra (GIS_…, CIV_…; waits for its answer) or a host command (e.g. 'ZOOM EXTENTS'). See GIS_HELP and CIV_HELP for the arguments.
name: infra_oi_command

description: Set the project location and import area: RD centre (x, y) or WGS84 (lon, lat), width and height in m. Everything else works in this area.
name: infra_oi_site

description: Import a dataset into the project area on NLCS layers: bgt, brk, luchtfoto, kadastrale_kaart, ahn_kaart, bag, percelen, nwb, hectometer, spoor, osm, osm_kaart, satelliet, tekenblad, ahn_hoogtelijnen, ahn_hoogtepunten, ahn_puntenwolk
name: infra_gis_import

description: Search the catalogue of about 620 public WMS, WFS and XYZ tile services in 50+ countries (cadastral parcels, aerial photos, elevation, geology, zoning, buildings …). Free text in Dutch or English (e.g. 'cadastral parcels Bavaria', 'luchtfoto', 'Flurstücke'); `here` keeps only services covering the project location, or give lon/lat. Returns id, type, name, provider, country, coverage, category, url, default_layer, crs (request CRS first), license and bbox per service. country filters ISO codes separated by semicolons, e.g. US;GLOBAL; omit it for all regions.
name: infra_gis_services

description: Load one layer of a catalogue service (id from gis_services) into the project area: WMS and tiles as images, WFS as features with attributes, reprojected to the project CRS. `layer` defaults to the service's preset layer.
name: infra_gis_service_load

description: Find legacy IMRO/TAM plans at an RD point or the project location. Requires OPENINFRA_RP_API_KEY in the plugin process; never pass a key as an argument. Returns plan IDs, status and dates.
name: infra_planning_search

description: Download a selected legacy IMRO/TAM plan as editable styled geometry. Requires local OPENINFRA_RP_API_KEY and a project location.
name: infra_planning_import

description: Import local IMRO GML with planning styles and source metadata; no API key required.
name: infra_planning_gml

description: NLCS 5.02 check of the drawing (report beside the drawing); repair=true sets layer styles and ByLayer.
name: infra_nlcs_check

description: The NLCS design as a BGT mutation (IMGeo-GML 2.1.1) with a report, beside the drawing. Layers N become plan topography (as_built=true: built), R built (changed when it carries a BGT lokaal_id), V ends the BGT object. Type and function come from the BGT object data, the BGT object beneath or the NLCS layer; ambiguous objects are listed in the report, not exported.
name: infra_bgt_mutation

description: Export the drawing as IFC 4.3 (IFC4X3_ADD2), beside it as <drawing>_IFC4X3.ifc or to `path`. Every object becomes its IFC class from its NLCS layer and object data: terrain (TIN, photo terrain), 3D BAG and CityGML buildings, pavements, green, water, structures, cables and pipes, sewers, earthworks, CPTs and boreholes (IfcBorehole with IfcGeotechnicalStratum); axes become IfcAlignments with horizontal and vertical layout. Georeferenced from the project location; object data as property sets. Answers with the counts per IFC class.
name: infra_ifc_export

description: Quantities per NLCS layer (count, length, area) as CSV beside the drawing.
name: infra_quantities

description: Import a survey point file (PNEZD/PENZD/CSV; separator and decimal comma detected).
name: infra_civ_points_import

description: Place survey points; without z the ground height (TIN or AHN) is used.

items.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_points

description: Export the drawing's points (or the selection) to a point file.
name: infra_civ_points_export

description: Import LandXML: points, surfaces (TIN) and alignments (lines, curves, spirals).
name: infra_civ_landxml

description: Make a terrain (TIN, 3D faces on OG-TRIANGULATIE): from AHN in the project area, the survey points, the selection or a layer. status N makes a design surface.

status.description: B = existing ground, N = design surface

name: infra_civ_tin

description: Contour lines of a terrain (default: existing ground).

surface.description: B = existing ground, N = design surface

name: infra_civ_contours

description: Height analysis: the terrain coloured in height bands with a legend.

surface.description: B = existing ground, N = design surface

name: infra_civ_analysis

description: Earthwork (cut/fill m³): design surface (N, or selected faces) against the existing ground, or the ground against a level.
name: infra_civ_volume

description: Create an axis (alignment) with stationing, tangent points and radii: through points of intersection with curve radii (by layout), or from a line by handle.

items.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_alignment

description: Offset lines beside an axis (m; left < 0).

axis.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

name: infra_civ_offsets

description: Station and offset of points relative to an axis.

axis.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

items.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_station

description: Length profile of an axis over the existing terrain (TIN, else AHN), with stationing, heights and alignment band.

axis.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

at.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_length_profile

description: Design (vertical) profile of an axis from PVIs [station, height] with parabolic vertical curves; drawn in its length profile.

axis.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

name: infra_civ_design_profile

description: Cross sections along an axis over the terrain, in a grid of views.

axis.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

at.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_cross_sections

description: Corridor: an assembly swept along an axis and its design profile (or a level / height above ground), daylight to the ground, design TIN (N), feature lines, cut/fill per section and volumes; optional section views.

axis.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

sections_at.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_corridor

description: 3D feature line (OG-BREUKLIJN, object data) from a line or points: heights from the ground (with grade breaks), from a start level and grades per segment (%), or fixed levels at corners ('2.5;;3' or '1:2.5;4:3').

line.description: Handle of a line, polyline or feature line (hex); empty = the selection or points

items.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_feature_line

description: Edit a feature line in place: set a corner level (corner from 1, or the corner nearest 'at'), raise/lower all (dz), insert a height point at 'at', or a constant grade between two corners.

line.description: Handle of a line, polyline or feature line (hex); empty = the selection or points

at.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_feature_line_edit

description: Building plot plateau from a closed line or points at a level, optionally with a fall (% towards N/NE/E/…/NW or degrees), sloping to the existing ground with separate cut and fill slopes (1:n); joins the combined design surface (N).

line.description: Handle of a line, polyline or feature line (hex); empty = the selection or points

items.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

level_point.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_plateau

description: Slope from a (feature) line on one side: to the ground (cut/fill slopes), over a width, or to a level; joins the design surface.

line.description: Handle of a line, polyline or feature line (hex); empty = the selection or points

items.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_slope

description: Exact cut and fill (prismoidal, TIN against TIN) of the design against the existing ground, with bulking and compaction factors and a cut/fill map in colour bands. design: BOUWRIJP (gradings only), PEIL (a level) or empty (selection / design surface N).
name: infra_civ_volume_tin

description: Mass haul diagram of an axis from its corridor's cut and fill per section (or measured on the TINs): balance points, haul (m³·km), free haul and overhaul, surplus/shortage; drawn as a graph, returned per station.

axis.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

at.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_mass_haul

description: The corridor assemblies (profieltypen): presets and the user's JSON files in <config>/OpenCADStudio/open-infra/assemblies/, with their parts per side (lanes, gutters, kerbs, footways, cycle paths, parking, verges, central reserve, ditches), pavement layers, conditions (cut/fill) and targets. With name: one in detail; copy_to copies it as a start for your own; at draws it as a template section.

at.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_assemblies

description: A corridor with any assembly (preset or own JSON) over a station range, e.g. from a junction's or roundabout's mouth (their result gives 'VAN=…' or 'TOT=…' per arm); targets are named lines in the drawing for width or level targets.

axis.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

name: infra_civ_corridor_range

description: A T or X junction of a main road and a side road (axes with design profiles): corner radii per corner (CROW-based default 8 m, an estimate), kerb returns, the side road tied in to the main road's cross slope, a TIN patch; the result gives each arm's mouth station for its corridor.

main.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

side.description: Handle of the axis (hex, from civ_alignment or oi_status); empty = the selection

name: infra_civ_junction

description: A single-lane roundabout after CROW publication 126 on 2+ axes (3–6 arms): outer diameter, carriageway, overrunnable strip, entry and exit radii and splitter islands; 2D layout and a 3D surface falling outward. The result gives each arm's mouth station.

centre.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z], project coordinates (m)

name: infra_civ_roundabout

description: 3D BAG buildings of the project area (LoD 1.2, 1.3 or 2.2): roof and wall meshes per building. style: mooi (roof colours from the aerial photo, walls by building year, windows per storey, crisp planes), maquette (white architectural model), realistisch (two plain colours) or nlcs (layer colours).
name: infra_civ_bag3d

description: The AHN ground of the project area as a 3D surface coloured by the PDOK aerial photo.
name: infra_civ_photo_terrain

description: A water surface at a level (m NAP) over the project area, to see what floods; call again with another level to move it. Returns the share of the area below that level (AHN ground).
name: infra_civ_water_level

description: Import any map server of the catalogue by id (PDOK, 600 worldwide services, HisGIS, Topotijdreis, the user's own): tile/WMS as image, WFS as vectors. year gives Topotijdreis of that year (1815-2014).
name: infra_gis_server

description: KLIC cables and pipes as 3D tubes under the AHN ground (depth from the delivery, else the usual cover depth per network type), in IMKL colours. Without path: the delivery imported last. scale thickens the tubes for overview pictures.
name: infra_civ_klic3d

description: Make the ground surfaces transparent (percent, default 70) so cables, pipes and CPT columns show beneath; all=true also buildings; percent=0 makes the ground opaque again.
name: infra_civ_see_through

description: Import a CityGML file (2.0 or 3.0, also IMGeo/BGT GML) or CityJSON (1.x/2.0, also CityJSONSeq .jsonl) as 3D meshes in the project area: buildings with roof and wall meshes (LoD1/LoD2, walls by year of construction), roads, green, water, bridges and relief on NLCS layers; 2D objects draped on the AHN. The file's CRS is transformed to the project location.
name: infra_civ_citygml

description: BGT in 3D: areas draped on the ground, buildings and walls extruded to the AHN surface, water at its level, bridges at deck height, posts and trees as symbols.
name: infra_civ_bgt3d

description: The subsurface from the BRO (Dutch key register, successor of DINOloket): cone penetration tests (CPT) and geotechnical boreholes (BHR-GT) of the project area as 3D columns from the surface level (m NAP) down, one mesh per soil layer coloured by soil type (sand yellow, clay green, peat brown, silt grey-green, gravel orange); CPT layers from qc and Rf (Robertson 2010 SBT), boreholes from their described soil names; qc/Rf graphs beside the CPTs. plan_only=true draws just the plan symbols with BRO id (no measurements fetched). Returns per column the BRO id, surface level and layers.
name: infra_civ_subsurface

description: Sewer hydraulics of a CIV_RIOOL network: design flow per pipe (rain on the connected paved area, dry weather flow of inhabitants or dwellings, infiltration), filling and velocity, optionally the smallest standard diameter (auto_diameter), and the hydraulic grade line from the outfall with manholes where water reaches the street; the grade line is drawn in the length profile.
name: infra_civ_sewer_hydraulics

description: Export LandXML 1.2: survey points, TINs (existing and design), alignments with ground and design profile, corridor feature lines.

path.description: Output file; empty = beside the drawing

all.description: Everything (default); false = only the objects in the selection

name: infra_civ_landxml_export

description: Set the view: preset (TOP, SWISO, SEISO, NEISO, NWISO, FRONT…), visual style (GOURAUDSHADED, FLATSHADED, WIREFRAME2D, HIDDENLINE…) and zoom to extents.
name: infra_oi_view

description: Capture the drawing viewport as PNG (returned as an image). region = [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in drawing coordinates.
name: infra_oi_capture

description: Save the drawing (QSAVE), or as a new file with path.
name: infra_oi_save

description: Open a drawing (DWG/DXF) or start a new one from a template.
name: infra_oi_open

description: The state (SuperCloud): which drawing is open, the project location and the model (axes, profiles, corridors, terrains with handles).
name: infra_stand

description: Open a drawing from the container's work folder (SuperCloud: Docs puts the file there).
name: infra_open

description: Save the drawing to its path (SuperCloud: Docs keeps it as a new version), or to `path`.
name: infra_opslaan
